title: Senior Frontend Architect & Team Leader
description:
Experience across many areas of software development.
From the management of servers, databases and systems administration, to the design of interfaces, through the complete development of frontend and backend web applications, where I carry out most of my activity as a developer.

Team worker, decisive, knowledgeable about good practices and clean code.
educationName1: Graphic Design and Desktop Publishing, Graphic Design.
educationName2: Higher Technician in Telecommunications and Computer Systems.
cccPosition: Senior Frontend Architect and team lead
cccDescription:
Frontend architecture definition, technical leadership, and engineering team management for real-time analytics platforms and enterprise web applications.

Architected and delivered Evidences Insight (RFEI), a high-throughput data extraction and processing platform for scientific and clinical literature with real-time reporting capabilities.

Led the implementation of Ticket Management (RFTKT), an operational real-time issue tracking system.

Engineered Search & Analytics (RFSA), an enriched semantic search platform tailored for the pharmaceutical and life sciences sector.
nttDataDescription:
Technical leadership and cross-functional team coordination as Center Leader Specialist (CLS), defining frontend architectural patterns and development standards across enterprise projects.

Spearheaded frontend development for the European Patent Office (EPO) and delivered MetAJob, a digital platform connecting employment counselors and job seekers.

Contributed to backend services by designing and implementing REST API middleware for the iPasen regional educational ecosystem (Andalusian Regional Government).
betixDescription:
Frontend engineering for mission-critical, high-traffic ticketing platforms serving major sports and retail organizations including FC Barcelona, Real Madrid, Atlético de Madrid, El Corte Inglés, Getafe FC, Albacete Balompié, and Elche CF.

Engineered proprietary JavaScript libraries for interactive 360º 3D venue visualizations and seat selection.

Developed internal automation pipelines and toolsets for 3D rendering workflows utilizing Node.js, Python (Cinema 4D), and Shell scripting.

Led advanced digital analytics implementations using Google Tag Manager (GTM) and Adobe DTM, ensuring rigorous testing coverage and reliable production releases.
crealogixDescription:
Fullstack web application engineering covering frontend and backend requirements, feature delivery, and production support.

Delivered prominent digital initiatives including the Danone S.A. corporate portal and the «Eres Impulso» web application for FontVella.

Streamlined engineering workflows, managed team GitHub repositories, and authored comprehensive technical documentation.
ximdexDescription:
Fullstack development and technical support for Ximdex's XML-based semantic CMS, building core modules (XFIND, XOWL, XLYRE, XRANK) and interactive demos. Delivered key platforms including the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) portal, BRAE, and corporate sites for Open Ximdex Evolution and United English Academy.

Built accessible and responsive interfaces with AngularJS, Riot.js, Sass, and UI asset design. On the backend, worked with PHP, SQL, and structured data (XML, JSON-LD), integrating ElasticSearch, Solr, and Kibana, alongside production deployments and client support under Scrum.
existoDescription:
End-to-end development, evolution, and technical support for the company's proprietary CMS engine (e-conecta).

Built custom corporate portals and e-commerce platforms tailored to diverse industry verticals.

Delivered web solutions for enterprise clients including Hispasat Group, Mercer Hoteles Barcelona, Tramas + Malbatex, Centro BTT Nevada, Fourup, and Planvalore Avales Inmobiliarios.
freelanceDescription:
End-to-end fullstack development of custom web portals and educational applications.

Designed and built the full online student platform for the Andalusian Interuniversity Institute of Criminology at the University of Seville.
gaesaDescription:
Fullstack development of e-learning platforms and interactive multimedia web applications.

Produced interactive educational courseware and modules with Adobe Flash and ActionScript 3.0 for regional public administration projects under the Andalusian Regional Government.
